Name: KNOCKBACK_PARAM_ST
Description: Timing of the knockback push a character gets from a hit. The hit sets the push direction and distance; when the damage or guard reaction starts the knockback, the row's entry for that reaction sets how the distance is covered: full speed for the Full Speed Time, then a linear slow-down to a stop over the Deceleration Time. The total distance stays the same, so the speed is distance ÷ (full speed time + deceleration time ÷ 2). Players use their body armour's Knockback Param ID (retail: row 1), NPCs their NpcParam Knockback Param ID (retail: row 0).
